purpose: The exact entry modules/general-cpu-scheduling contributes to the single assembled kueue-scheduling.json. The assembler merges it into cpu_classes under the key general-cpu; it does not restate any of these values, because every one of them is derived from deployment.cpu_pools and the general lane configuration.

kueue_objects_owned_by_this_producer.note: The assembler must not render these; it consumes the class entry only. The general lane owns them, the reference-data plane owns its own, and no object has two owners.

producer_publishes: the canonical general-cpu class entry above
external lane facts: the ClusterQueue, LocalQueue, namespace and nominal quota of the objects this producer owns
assembler_does: merge the entry into cpu_classes as-is, without adapting or restating it
describe the producer's queues as external lanes without becoming their owner
publish one immutable content-addressed ConfigMap and inject its name, key and digest into the chart
handshake.controller: Hash the raw mounted bytes and compare them with the injected digest before enabling writes. Persist the resolved resource_flavor, pool_resolution.pool_id and cpu/memory/ephemeral_storage quantities, keep QuotaReserved and Admitted as separate states with separate timestamps, and enforce eligible_pool_ids rather than trusting only runtime-reported compatibility.
